description: Address v2 code review issues: (1) UNIQUE constraint blocks cancelled-slot rebooking, (2) DocumentService::delete() path traversal, (3) Consent grant/revoke missing CSRF protection.
steps: Remove the unconditional UNIQUE KEY on (id_resource, booking_date, time_start, time_end) from install.sql and add a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locking approach in BookingFrontProvider::createBooking() to prevent double-booking while allowing cancelled-slot rebooking
Extract path validation into a private resolveSecurePath() helper in DocumentService.php and use it in both download() and delete()
Require POST method and CSRF token validation in consent.php handleGrant() and handleRevoke() methods, and add CSRF token hidden fields to consent.tpl forms
acceptance_criteria: install.sql no longer has uniq_medbook_booking_slot UNIQUE KEY on (id_resource, booking_date, time_start, time_end)
BookingFrontProvider::createBooking() uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE to lock the resource row during slot validation to prevent race conditions
DocumentService::delete() validates file paths using the same realpath() logic as download()
consent.php handleGrant() and handleRevoke() only execute on POST requests with valid CSRF token
consent.tpl forms include a hidden CSRF token field
All PHP files pass syntax check
verification: Run: grep 'FOR UPDATE' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/src/Service/BookingFrontProvider.php to confirm locking
Run: grep 'resolveSecurePath' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/src/Service/DocumentService.php to confirm helper usage in delete()
Run: grep 'isPost\|POST\|token' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/controllers/front/consent.php to confirm CSRF protection
Run: grep 'token' /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/views/templates/front/consent.tpl to confirm token field in forms
Run: find /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/ -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v 'No syntax errors'
